summary: PASS with one Low, non-mandatory finding (F-DG0-249). The D-039 strict validator closes every round-22 exploit. The forged-absent-round all-zero fix (QA22-N7 / F-DG0-246) is rejected. Absent, missing, null and 'unknown' heads are rejected in gate and non-gate rounds. A later-round sidecar cannot change severity, mandatory_violation, requirement or title, and rounds are ordered numerically. Shallow clones (--depth=1/3, --shallow-exclude) are refused. The orphans 450c756 and cb76260 are gone from every clone mode. The full-history dry-run shows 0 PRUNED, RECORD-LESS and DROPPED errors, with identical output on --no-local and plain clones. All 110 fix_revisions are present ancestors of HEAD. All suites pass (gates 62/62, agents 39/39 + 22 Python), and the pre-freeze passes 11/11. The live guard blocks file-tool and shell writes. F-DG0-246/247/248 are CLOSED_VERIFIED. F-DG0-249 (Low): checkClosure still skips the round-ancestry check for a self-declared absent round, so a real in-gate fix that the verifying run's head does not contain can close a finding. Proposal: also bind the fix to head_commit_at_start. No real closure is affected.
